name: YTL Johor Green Data Center Park
notes: YTL describes a Johor data centre park powered by up to 500MW of on-site solar; trade press reports NVIDIA-powered AI facility completed at the Kulai campus.

name: AirTrunk JHB1 Johor Bahru
notes: JHB1 opened in July 2024; DCD reports full build-out above 150MW, with initial phases above 50MW.

name: AirTrunk JHB2 Johor Bahru
notes: Second Malaysia hyperscale campus announced for Johor, cloud and AI-ready, with more than 270MW of IT load.

name: AirTrunk JHB3 and JHB4 Johor Bahru campuses
notes: AirTrunk announced two additional Johor Bahru campuses, JHB3 and JHB4, adding more than 280MW of IT load near JHB1/JHB2.

name: Princeton Digital Group JH1 Sedenak Tech Park
notes: PDG lists JH1 in Sedenak Tech Park, Kulai, with 80,000 sqm colocation area and 200MW capacity.

name: Princeton Digital Group JH2 Eco Business Park Senai
notes: PDG lists JH2 about 16km from JH1; Baxtel places it at Eco Business Park, Mukim Senai, optimized for hyperscale and AI.

name: Vantage JHB1 / former Yondr Sedenak campus
notes: Vantage acquired Yondr's nearly 73-acre Sedenak campus, expected to deliver more than 300MW across three data centers; Yondr had reported the first 98MW milestone.

name: Equinix JH1 Iskandar Puteri
notes: Equinix lists JH1 at Nusajaya/Iskandar Puteri; trade press reports 6MW and launch in 2024.

name: Equinix JH2 Iskandar Puteri
notes: Second Johor IBX topped out; reported initial phase around 7.2MW/1,100 racks, with broader campus expansion potential.

name: DayOne Nusajaya Tech Park Campus
notes: DayOne lists Johor as part of its SIJORI platform; data center directory reports Nusajaya 1-3 phase 1 with 69.5MW IT power.

name: GDC SDK1 Sedenak Tech Park
notes: Directories report GDC SDK1 as a 21MW high-density AI data center in Sedenak Tech Park with capacity for about 1,000 racks.

name: GDC Kulim Data Center
developer: Global Data Centre Sdn Bhd / Maxland Bhd
notes: Baxtel reports a proposed collaboration for a hyperscale data centre campus in Kulim Hi-Tech Park, Kedah, with 45MW cited.

name: DPS Resources Bukit Rambai AI Data Center
notes: Baxtel reports an 88MW AI data center at Lot 76, Bukit Rambai, Melaka; DPS has an AI data center business page with proposed Melaka sites.

name: DPS Resources Lendu/Kelemak AI Data Center
notes: DPS source identifies proposed Lendu and Kelemak Melaka sites; public company-linked post describes a proposed 500MW data center at Lendu.

name: DPS Resources and Alibaba-affiliate Melaka AI Data Center
developer: DPS Resources Berhad / Artificial General Intelligence Technology Ltd
notes: MOU to explore a Melaka project estimated at 150MW-180MW and US$1.1bn-US$1.35bn development cost.

name: GDC Malacca Campus
notes: Baxtel reports Global Data Centre's Melaka project as a carrier-neutral AI-based data centre investment for the state.

name: Gamuda Springhill Industrial Park / Port Dickson Data Centre Campus
notes: Gamuda-linked sources report 158ha/389-acre Springhill Industrial Park land for cloud and data centre infrastructure; analyst estimate cited by Gamuda says 700MW-1,000MW possible.

name: Port Dickson hyperscale data centre contract
developer: Gamuda Bhd / unnamed US technology firm
notes: Gamuda secured a RM1.71bn contract to construct a single-storey hyperscale data centre in Port Dickson; reported as its second such contract in the area in 2026.

name: Pahang Technology Park data center hub
notes: MIDA/Bernama report state focus on data centre investors and MDEC-identified locations including Kuantan, Gambang, and Bentong; no named hyperscale tenant found.

name: Open DC PE2 Bayan Lepas Technology Park
notes: Open DC PE2 is in Bayan Lepas Technology Park; DCD reports the 30MW facility launched in August 2025 and is the largest on Penang island.

name: CSF / AIMS Suntech Penang Cybercity Service Centre
notes: Colocation/service facilities reported at SUNTECH Penang Cybercity/Bayan Baru; small facility, capacity not disclosed.

name: Privasia Silverstreams Data Centre Bagan Datuk
notes: Silverstreams official page lists 49-acre, three-storey project with power up to 25MW; DCD reported initial 10MW plan in Perak.

name: NexQuantum AI Digital Park NQ1
developer: Cahya Suria Services / Suzhou EnnoTHING Technology
notes: JV announced in Ipoh to develop NexQuantum AI Digital Park in Perak, with first phase NQ1 Tier 3 AI data center planned at 32MW.

name: Bandar Teknologi Maju Perlis data centre hub
notes: MIDA/Bernama report Perlis' first data centre hub concept with solar power at Bandar Teknologi Maju Perlis; DCD tag page references Area Group acquiring 150 acres for a northern Malaysia data center park.

name: Google Elmina Business Park Data Center and Cloud Region
notes: Google announced US$2bn Malaysia investment for its first data center and cloud region; Sime Darby Property reported official groundbreaking at Elmina Business Park in Selangor.

name: AWS Cyberjaya data center / Asia Pacific Malaysia Region
notes: AWS opened the Malaysia Region and has a RM29.2bn long-term investment plan; directory/source reports a Cyberjaya facility under construction with completion scheduled for Q2 2027.

name: Vantage Cyberjaya I KUL1 Campus
notes: Vantage official page lists 31MW across four buildings; DCD reported the final 16MW KUL14 building launched in December 2025.

name: Vantage Cyberjaya II KUL2 Campus
notes: Vantage official page lists a 52-acre Cyberjaya II campus with 6 data centers and 436MW critical IT load; Malaysian government source reports Vantage's additional Cyberjaya investment.

name: NEXTDC KL1 Petaling Jaya
notes: NEXTDC says KL1 in Petaling Jaya delivers 65MW of IT capacity; company announced go-live in May 2026.

name: Maxis i-City Data Centre Shah Alam
notes: Maxis lists its i-City Shah Alam data centre as a Tier III certified colocation facility; capacity not disclosed.

name: NTT Cyberjaya Data Centers
notes: NTT lists Cyberjaya data centers in Malaysia's IT hub and states ongoing investment in data center development.

name: TM Global Klang Valley Data Centre expansion
notes: DCD reported TM Global expansion of its Klang Valley Data Centre in Cyberjaya and Iskandar Puteri Data Centre, with combined approximately 20MW IT load in the second phase; Selangor share not separately disclosed.
